english: For real numbers $a$ and $b$, consider the planes

Suppose that the system of the three equations of $P_1$, $P_2$, $P_3$ in the unknowns $x,y,z$ has infinitely many solutions, so that the three planes have a common line $L$. If $(\alpha,\beta,\gamma)$ is the foot of the perpendicular drawn from the origin to $L$, then the value of $\alpha\beta$ is ______.
hindi: वास्तविक संख्याओं $a$ तथा $b$ के लिए तलों

पर विचार कीजिए। माना कि अज्ञात $x,y,z$ में $P_1$, $P_2$, $P_3$ के तीनों समीकरणों से बने निकाय के अनन्त हल हैं, जिससे तीनों तलों की एक उभयनिष्ठ रेखा $L$ है। यदि मूलबिन्दु से $L$ पर डाले गए लम्ब का पाद $(\alpha,\beta,\gamma)$ है, तो $\alpha\beta$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Then $(3,1,1)=(1,2,-1)+(2,-1,2)$, so consistency needs $b=2+1=3$; $P_3$ contains the line $P_1\cap P_2$
solution_full: If $D\neq0$ the system has a unique solution, so infinitely many solutions require $D=0$, i.e. $a=2$.

With $a=2$ the left sides satisfy $P_3=P_1+P_2$: $(1+2,\,2-1,\,-1+2)=(3,1,1)$. Subtracting the first two equations from the third leaves $0=b-3$, so the system is consistent only if $b=3$; then the third equation is redundant.
The normals $(1,2,-1)$ and $(2,-1,2)$ of $P_1$, $P_2$ are not parallel, so $P_1\cap P_2$ is a line $L$, and it lies in $P_3$; this gives the infinitely many solutions.
A point of $L$: put $z=0$; $x+2y=2$ and $2x-y=1$ give $x=\frac45$, $y=\frac35$. So $Q=\left(\frac45,\frac35,0\right)$ and $L:\ \vec r=\left(\frac45,\frac35,0\right)+t(3,-4,-5)$.
The foot $F$ of the perpendicular from $O$ satisfies $\overrightarrow{OF}\cdot(3,-4,-5)=0$: $\left(\frac45+3t\right)3+\left(\frac35-4t\right)(-4)+(-5t)(-5)=\frac{12}{5}-\frac{12}{5}+50t=0$, so $t=0$.
Hence $F=Q=\left(\frac45,\frac35,0\right)$, i.e. $\alpha=\frac45$, $\beta=\frac35$, $\gamma=0$, and the distance from $O$ to $L$ is $1$.
originality_note: New: the parameters of a three-plane system are fixed by 'infinitely many solutions', and the resulting common line is then used geometrically (foot of the perpendicular from the origin), which turns out to be the point of L in the plane z = 0 (way 5). Closest known: JEE Main 'system has infinitely many solutions, find a + b' and 'foot of perpendicular to a line' as separate exercises. Different because: the two are linked; the line exists only for the parameter values found from the system.

concept_use.System of linear equations: Infinitely many solutions force det = 5a - 10 = 0 and the consistency condition b = 3.
concept_use.Plane: L is the line of intersection of the planes, with direction n1 x n2 = (3,-4,-5); the foot of the perpendicular from O to L is found from this direction.
